title.narrative: Specific international standards and practices of justice introduced and applied at the ECCC.Number of cases investigated and judgements awarded.

description.narrative: Specific international standards and practices of justice introduced and applied at the ECCC.Number of cases investigated and judgements awarded.

comment.narrative: Despite the continuing support from the international community certain international standards have not been fully perceived by the Court.

The ECCC trials were conducted in a manner that it was transparent in which all parties could fully participate during all stages of legal procedures although Covid19 disrupted the court hearing in 2020 and 2021. The Courts resumed its hearing from late 2021 to 2022. As the results the case 003 and case 004 were completed as the Supreme Court Chamber decided not to send the case to the Trial Chamber due to the lack of jurisdictions against the accused. In late 2022 the Supreme Court Chamber pronounced the final verdict on case 0022 against Khiev Samphan retention of the Trial Chambers judgment for life imprisonment of the accused. The court pronouncement of the final verdict has contributed to the end of the impunity in Cambodia and justice has brought to Khmer Rouge survivors especially civil parties. Although no evidence or NGO report highlighted the perspective of citizens on the court some media outlets interviewed Khmer Rouge survivors and they expressed appreciation of the ECCC which brought to the end of impunity after several years of the court operations.

title.narrative: Amount of contributions paid to the national and international component of the Courts. Number of cases investigated and decisions made by the Court.

description.narrative: Amount of contributions paid to the national and international component of the Courts. Number of cases investigated and decisions made by the Court.

comment.narrative: Although the RGC UN and international donors have provided contributions to the ECCC within the number of years the passing of judgements on several cases requires more time and striving from the Courts side.

The ECCCs Work Plan was interrupted by Covid19 especially between 2020 and 2021. However the court continued to apply both virtual and hybrid working arrangements. The decisions on case 003 and 004 were delayed due to the contradicted indictments of the national and international prosecutors. Several motions were filled by the parties to the court and the PreTrial Chamber and the Supreme Court Chamber addressed their response during the mentioned periods. In late 2021 and in early 2022 the Supreme Court Chamber decided to close the two cases respectively. Therefore the ECCCs work plan was completed during period of the project implementation. Regarding the payment national and international staff were paid as planned.

description.narrative: Result 3

title.narrative: Percentage of citizens within the specific groups have been reached by the Awareness and Education Programme.

description.narrative: 1). At the end of project, approx. 70% of key youths and teachers increased knowledge related to KR history and specific soft skills which can share with others2). Approx. 70% of KR survivors felt more confident to share personal experience during the KR with young generation.

comment.narrative: 814 high school students 567 female or 70 and 229 high school teachers 132 female or 58 received trainings on the Khmer Rouge History on SGBV and other forms of violence. Based on the result from pre and posttest participants increased knowledge from 60 to 82.8 intergenerational dialogues were conducted in the eight provinces as planned. As a result the project engaged with a total of 634 427 female or 67 participants including 83 44 female or 53 KR survivors. Most KR survivors felt proud when they participated in oral history. They were delighted that their personal experiences could be shared with the next generation. 82 of them mentioned that they felt relief after sharing their personal history of the KR regime with students.

title.narrative: Overall objective

description.narrative: The General Objective is to promote human rights and rule of law, combat impunity and foster national reconciliation.

title.narrative: Judicial procedures comply with international standards. Respect for human rights and national reconciliation are ensured.

description.narrative: Judicial procedures comply with international standards. Respect for human rights and national reconciliation are ensured.

comment.narrative: Cambodian citizens do not have full trust in the judicial system in the state.

Domestic judicial standards are lifted through familiarising the Cambodia judiciary with international norms and standards for the administration of justice. ECCC legacy has impacted on the judicial system for instance the establishment of the court administrations of all levels of courts in Cambodia. The trust of the Cambodian people in the justice is gradually rebuilt through taking the example of the ECCC. Judicial officials such as judges prosecutors lawyers court clerks and other officials were trained how to comply with the international norm and standards of the judicial system.

title.narrative: Specific Objective

description.narrative: To support the ECCC through the remuneration packages to the staff serving on both national and international component and to implement Awareness and Education on Khmer Rouge History Programme

title.narrative: Progressed perception by the Cambodian citizens and international community in the actions of the Court.Increased knowledge on the history of Khmer Rouge regime.Provision of specific support to selected groups of survivors.

description.narrative: Progressed perception by the Cambodian citizens and international community in the actions of the Court.Increased knowledge on the history of Khmer Rouge regime.Provision of specific support to selected groups of survivors.

comment.narrative: ECCC adopted the best international standards and practices in its legal procedures. The project disbursed the EU contribution to the national and international components of the ECCC to ensure that they payment of the staff salary in time will not delay the legal procedure of the courts cases. For instance 3 disbursements to the national side and 2 disbursements to the international side were completed. Awareness and Education programme is implemented efficiently within the target groups. Two grantees were selected through the competitive process to implement the 20month projects one focused on developing the elearning platform about the ECCC and another one implemented education and awareness raising with students teachers Khmer Rouge survivors and the government officials. As the result of intervention students increased their knowledge about the Khmer Rouge history and the Khmer Rouge survivors were able to participate in the ECCCs hearings and attended the project outreach and awareness raising activities such as intergenerational dialogues oral history collection and so on.

The project disbursed the EU contribution to the national and international components of the ECCC to ensure that they payment of the staff salary in time will not delay the legal procedure of the courts cases. For instance 3 disbursements to the national side and 2 disbursements to the international side were completed. Awareness and Education programme is implemented efficiently within the target groups. Two grantees were selected through the competitive process to implement the 20month projects one focused on developing the elearning platform about the ECCC and another one implemented education and awareness raising with students teachers Khmer Rouge survivors and the government officials. As the result of intervention students increased their knowledge about the Khmer Rouge history and the Khmer Rouge survivors were able to participate in the ECCCs hearings and attended the project outreach and awareness raising activities such as intergenerational dialogues oral history collection and so on.
